alignments.note: The noun of אֲחֵיהֶם takes *brethren*; the suffix is its own unit (rules 11, 18).
Passive participle → *were appointed*; head on the lexical predicate, not the auxiliary (rule 24).
Construct עֲבוֹדַת with a supplied *the*: an outer construct in a multi-level chain takes a supplied article (rule 29).
*of* with the rectum (rule 19); the second English *the* is supplied for this outer construct (rule 29).
Construct בֵּית takes *of ... house*; the *the* at t016 is the article morpheme's, so this unit is discontinuous (rules 25, 29).
The article on the rectum takes the *the* the ASV fronts to *the house*, since a present article morpheme takes its English before a supplied one does (rule 29).
*of God*; the rectum is rendered anarthrously and its article stands at t016 (rules 19, 29).

review_notes: Three-level construct chain *service — tabernacle — house — God* with a single article morpheme. Following rule 29, that article takes the innermost written *the* (*the house*) and the two outer constructs take supplied ones. The competing reading gives the article the leftmost *the* (*the service*); rule 29's parenthetical about the article leaving the second *the* for the outer construct is what decided against it.
